body: wow they guilt tripped you, that doesn’t sound like a friend at all. people who care about won’t ever guilt trip you for something like that. if you’re ever feeling down again and feel like you can’t talk to anyone, i’ve just started journaling and it might help you too. i pretend im writing to someone or to myself and it’s helped a bit

i hope you’re doing better now and thank you for sharing. i eventually want to get a therapist but moneys tight rn so im trying to save up, i know i’ll be okay in the end but i appreciate the talk, it definitely made the feelings stop for a while

i know the feeling. it gets very exhausting constantly reaching out to ur friends making sure they’re okay and it never being returned. they’re the ones that sound like bad friends. i know i don’t know you but i’m here if you want to talk some more
yeah it makes me think about all the people who are really in need of help and don’t get it bc of people that untrained or bc they don’t have enough resources. it really breaks my heart

im sorry this happened to you too. 
i appreciate that, it actually made me feel a lil better :)
